question:
Snowflake supports multi-table inserts: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/sql/insert-multi-table.html

I'm wondering if there is a way to do that in dbt. Can be useful when you have 1 source table that should be transformed into several target tables. For example, this is a typical use case in Data Vault.
title: Multi-table insert in dbt (1 select -> several target tables)
answer:
AFAIK you can create models with any statement and dbt will send its to your database, as long as your database can understand those statements, the dbt model should work properly.

Suppose we have a source table called customer and 3 target tables where we want to insert the data from the source. We could create a model in the models folder as follow:

models/my_model.sql

INSERT ALL 
    WHEN USAGE > 100 
        THEN INTO TABLE1(NAME, USAGE) VALUES (NAME, USAGE)
    WHEN USAGE > 50 AND USAGE <= 100
        THEN INTO TABLE2(NAME, USAGE) VALUES(NAME, USAGE)
    ELSE
        INTO TABLE3(NAME,USAGE) VALUES(NAME, USAGE)
SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER;

Have you tried this approach? Did you get any error? Could you share the code to be able to reproduce the error?
